parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the door of the safe, made of steel, rectangular in shape, and attached to the main body with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main barrier to secure the contents inside the safe, providing protection against unauthorized access.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open or close the safe.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the safe, made of plastic, small in size, and located on the door.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to operate the locking mechanism, allowing the user to open or lock the safe.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or push/pull depending on the locking design.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: This is a small external component, likely part of the hinge or locking mechanism, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door’s movement or contributes to the locking system’s stability.
parts.Movement_description: It may rotate slightly or remain fixed depending on its role in the hinge or lock.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the safe, made of thick steel, forming the structural enclosure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main protective housing for the contents, ensuring resistance to force and heat.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed frame for the door and internal components.
